title: Emotion- and Region-Specific Gaze Differences in Parents of Children With Autism Spectrum Disorder.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study examined gaze behavior during emotional face processing in parents of children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and assessed whether their visual attention patterns differ from those of parents of typically developing children.
METHODS: Thirty-five parents of children with ASD and 35 matched parents of typically developing children participated. Using an eyetracking paradigm, we analyzed gaze allocation across 2 key facial regions while processing 4 emotional expressions.
RESULTS: The analysis revealed no main effect of parents of children with ASD in gaze metrics, however, the interaction effect results of entry time group×areas of interest group showed parents of children with ASD showed a selective increase in attention to the mouth specifically for threat-related emotional faces (angry and fearful).
CONCLUSION: These findings provide evidence for an emotion- and region-specific pattern of gaze allocation in parents of children with ASD. These interaction-based findings, characterized by small effect sizes, suggest that gaze differences in parents of children with ASD are specific to certain facial regions and emotional expressions, rather than reflecting a generalized attentional difference. Future research should investigate the underlying mechanisms of these gaze patterns and their implications for real-life social dynamics, including parent-child interactions.

标题：自闭症谱系障碍儿童父母的情绪和区域特异性凝视差异
摘要：目的：本研究考察了自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）儿童父母在情绪面孔加工过程中的凝视行为，并评估了他们的视觉注意模式是否与正常发育儿童父母存在差异。  
方法：35名ASD儿童父母与35名匹配的正常发育儿童父母参与研究。采用眼动追踪范式，分析他们在加工4种情绪表达时对两个关键面部区域的注视分配。  
结果：分析显示，ASD儿童父母在凝视指标上无主效应，但交互效应（入注时间×兴趣区域组）表明，ASD儿童父母在面对威胁相关情绪面孔（愤怒和恐惧）时，对嘴部的关注选择性增强。  
结论：这些发现为ASD儿童父母的凝视分配存在情绪和区域特异性模式提供了证据。这些基于交互效应的发现（效应量较小）提示，ASD儿童父母的凝视差异仅针对特定面部区域和情绪表达，而非反映普遍的注意差异。未来研究应探究这些凝视模式的潜在机制及其对现实社交动态（包括亲子互动）的影响。  
关键词：自闭症谱系障碍儿童父母；眼动追踪；情绪面部加工；凝视分配；威胁相关情绪

title: Knowledge-guided diffusion for emotion and topic controllable text generation.
summary: Controllable text generation faces challenges in coordinating conflicting specifications while maintaining factual consistency. Existing methods apply constraints uniformly regardless of compatibility, rely on static annotations, and ignore knowledge relevance shifts across generation stages. We propose a knowledge-guided diffusion framework with three innovations. First, conflict-aware fusion detects emotion-topic incompatibility via learned projections and adaptively balances constraints. Second, hierarchical relation-aware encoding categorizes 847 relation types into semantic categories with category-specific transformations. Third, trajectory-aware weighting models knowledge relevance evolution, emphasizing semantic grounding early and details late. We enrich three datasets (Wizard of Wikipedia, GoEmotions, WebNLG) through automatic annotation aligned with inference. Experiments show substantial improvements: 69.5% emotion accuracy and 76.8% topic relevance versus baseline 61.3% and 68.4%; 71.9% factual F1 on WebNLG versus 66.7%. Human evaluation confirms quality gains (3.9/5 vs. 3.6/5). Critically, improvements concentrate on difficult, high-conflict, sparse-knowledge cases (62% vs. 54% and 47%), addressing fundamental coordination challenges.

标题：知识引导的扩散模型用于情绪与主题可控文本生成
摘要：可控文本生成在协调相互冲突的规范并保持事实一致性方面面临挑战。现有方法无论规范是否兼容均统一施加约束，依赖静态标注，且忽略了知识相关性在不同生成阶段的变化。我们提出了一种知识引导的扩散框架，包含三项创新。首先，冲突感知融合通过习得的投影检测情绪-主题不相容性，并自适应地平衡约束。其次，层次化关系感知编码将847种关系类型划分为语义类别，并应用类别特定的变换。第三，轨迹感知加权对知识相关性的演变进行建模，早期强调语义基础，后期关注细节。我们通过自动化标注（与推理对齐）丰富了三个数据集（Wizard of Wikipedia、GoEmotions、WebNLG）。实验表明显著改进：情绪准确率达69.5%，主题相关性达76.8%，而基线分别为61.3%和68.4%；在WebNLG上的事实F1得分为71.9%，基线为66.7%。人工评估确认了质量提升（3.9/5 vs. 3.6/5）。关键改进集中在困难、高冲突、稀疏知识的案例（62% vs. 54%和47%），解决了基本的协调挑战。
关键词：可控文本生成；情绪；主题；知识引导扩散；冲突感知融合

title: Neural selectivity for social interactions in the infant brain.
summary: Social cognition develops in the second year of life. Yet even in the first months, infants show sophisticated representation of social interactions. The neural structures supporting these early capacities remain unknown. Here, using functional near-infrared spectroscopy, we show that, like adults, preverbal infants exhibit selective increase in the activity of posterior superior-temporal and temporo-parietal regions when viewing individuals facing and moving toward (vs. away from) each other, as if interacting. No reliable difference emerged between 6- and 10-month-olds, although neural effects were more widespread in the older group, who also showed consistently longer looking times toward interacting dyads. Neural effects of social interactions were spatially distinct from effects of body motion perception, indicating separate mechanisms for perceiving biological agents and interacting agents. The early tuning to visuo-spatial cues of social engagement documented here may orient infants' attention toward social interactions, thereby facilitating the discovery and learning of human social relationships.

标题：婴儿大脑对社会互动的神经选择性  
摘要：社会认知在生命第二年发展，但即使在最初几个月，婴儿已表现出对社会互动的复杂表征。支持这些早期能力的神经结构尚不明确。本研究使用功能性近红外光谱技术发现，与成人相似，前言语婴儿在观察个体面对面并朝向彼此移动（而非远离）时，其后颞上回和颞顶联合区的活动选择性增强，仿佛他们在互动。6个月和10个月大的婴儿之间未出现可靠差异，尽管年长组神经效应更广泛，且对互动双方面对面的注视时间始终更长。社会互动的神经效应与身体运动感知的效应在空间上分离，表明感知生物体和感知互动体存在独立机制。本研究揭示的早期对社会互动视觉空间线索的调谐，可能引导婴儿注意力转向社会互动，从而促进对人类社交关系的发现与学习。  
关键词：社会互动；婴儿大脑；神经选择性；后颞上回；功能性近红外光谱

title: Tinnitus and tinnitus disorder: Genetic, neurobiological, and clinical differentiation.
summary: Tinnitus is the conscious perception of sound in the absence of an external acoustic source. When accompanied by emotional distress, cognitive dysfunction, or autonomic arousal leading to behavioral and functional impairment, it is termed "tinnitus disorder." This perspective synthesizes genetic, epidemiological, and neuroimaging evidence supporting the distinction between tinnitus and tinnitus disorder. Genetic studies indicate that tinnitus is linked to multiple common variants of small effect size, whereas tinnitus disorder involves rarer variants exerting larger effects. Epidemiologically, hearing loss is the primary risk factor for tinnitus, whereas personality traits like neuroticism, mood, and sleep disturbances predict tinnitus disorder. Neuroimaging identifies three interrelated neural pathways: a lateral "loudness" pathway, a descending "inhibitory" pathway, and a medial "distress" pathway that is specifically activated in tinnitus disorder, providing a neural basis for tinnitus related suffering. Future needs include the establishment of standardized diagnostic criteria and a severity grading system of tinnitus disorder.

标题：耳鸣与耳鸣障碍：遗传、神经生物学及临床区分  
摘要：耳鸣是在无外界声源刺激时对声音的有意识感知。当伴随情绪困扰、认知功能障碍或自主神经唤醒，并导致行为和功能损伤时，则被称为“耳鸣障碍”。本文从遗传学、流行病学和神经影像学证据出发，支持耳鸣与耳鸣障碍之间的区分。遗传研究表明，耳鸣与多个效应较小的常见变异相关，而耳鸣障碍则涉及效应较大的罕见变异。从流行病学角度看，听力损失是耳鸣的主要风险因素，而神经质人格特质、情绪和睡眠障碍则预测耳鸣障碍。神经影像学识别出三个相互关联的神经通路：侧向的“响度”通路、下行的“抑制”通路以及内侧的“痛苦”通路，该通路在耳鸣障碍中被特异性激活，为耳鸣相关的痛苦提供了神经基础。未来的需求包括建立耳鸣障碍的标准化诊断标准和严重程度分级系统。  
关键词：耳鸣；耳鸣障碍；情绪困扰；神经影像；人格特质

title: Emotion correction for weibo users via weakly supervised learning and semantic understanding.
summary: With the fast pace of modern society, individuals are facing increasing psychological stress and emotional challenges. As an important platform for public emotional expression, Weibo contains extensive textual data reflecting users' emotional states. This paper proposes an emotion correction approach for Weibo users that integrates weakly supervised learning with semantic understanding. The approach combines emotion recognition, emotion-cause classification, and personalized content recommendation, where the emotional polarity of Weibo texts is first identified, negative posts are then classified into corresponding emotion-cause categories, and positively oriented content related to users' emotion causes is subsequently recommended to provide targeted emotional support. Experiments on a real-world Weibo dataset show that the proposed approach achieves accuracies of 96.2% and 83.5% in emotion recognition and emotion-cause classification, respectively, while also delivering strong recommendation performance. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed model for supporting users' emotional correction and contributing to mental health.

标题：基于弱监督学习与语义理解的微博用户情绪校正方法
摘要：随着现代社会的快节奏，个体面临日益增长的心理压力和情绪挑战。微博作为公众情绪表达的重要平台，包含了反映用户情绪状态的大量文本数据。本文提出了一种融合弱监督学习与语义理解的微博用户情绪校正方法。该方法结合了情绪识别、情绪原因分类和个性化内容推荐，首先识别微博文本的情绪极性，然后将负面帖子分类到相应的情绪原因类别，最后推荐与用户情绪原因相关的正向内容，以提供针对性的情绪支持。在真实微博数据集上的实验表明，该方法在情绪识别和情绪原因分类上分别达到了96.2%和83.5%的准确率，同时展现了良好的推荐性能。这些结果验证了所提模型在支持用户情绪校正和促进心理健康方面的潜力。
关键词：情绪校正；弱监督学习；情绪识别；情绪原因分类；心理健康
